user.title: Apple BLE
user.description: Leave the model empty to auto-track the strongest nearby AirPods, or pin a specific model.

confirm.title: Add {model}
confirm.description: Add battery tracking for the discovered {model}?

abort.already_configured: This AirPods model is already configured.
abort.not_airpods: The discovered device is not AirPods.
abort.too_far: AirPods detected but too far away to auto-add. Open the case lid next to your Bluetooth adapter, or add them manually.

init.title: AirPods keys (optional)
init.description: Paste MagicAccIRK and MagicAccEncKey from your Mac keychain (item "MobileBluetooth", account = AirPods address). The IRK pins these exact AirPods; the EncKey unlocks exact battery % and the connected device. Leave empty to disable. Helper: scripts/airpods_keys.sh.

error.invalid_key: Must be 16 bytes of hex (e.g. FE-47-…).
